name: Richard Scott Kingston
original_name: リチャード・スコット・キングストン
source:
A friend and partner in crime of the protagonist from their days at Eaton College.

While everyone has moved away from Will, he maintains the same friendship with him.

His sister is the main character's fiancée.

[From [url=https://www.lune-soft.jp/game/7363]official site[/url]]
